name: select_literal
sql: SELECT 1 AS a, 'x' AS b, true AS c

name: integer_arithmetic
sql: SELECT 7 + 5 AS s, 7 - 5 AS d, 7 * 5 AS p, 7 % 5 AS m, 7 DIV 5 AS q

name: string_functions
sql: SELECT upper('abc'), concat('a', 'b'), substring('hello', 2, 3), length('héllo'), trim('  x  ')

name: range_count
sql: SELECT count(*) AS n, sum(id) AS s FROM range(100)

name: group_by
sql: SELECT k, count(*) AS n, sum(v) AS s FROM VALUES ('a', 1), ('b', 2), ('a', 3), ('b', 4), ('c', 5) AS t(k, v) GROUP BY k ORDER BY k

name: inner_join
sql: SELECT l.id, r.name FROM VALUES (1), (2), (3) AS l(id) JOIN VALUES (2, 'two'), (3, 'three'), (4, 'four') AS r(id, name) ON l.id = r.id ORDER BY l.id

name: left_join_null
sql: SELECT l.id, r.name FROM VALUES (1), (2) AS l(id) LEFT JOIN VALUES (2, 'two') AS r(id, name) ON l.id = r.id ORDER BY l.id

name: window_row_number
sql: SELECT v, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY v DESC) AS rn FROM VALUES (10), (30), (20) AS t(v) ORDER BY rn

name: cte
sql: WITH t AS (SELECT id FROM range(5)) SELECT max(id) FROM t

name: case_when
sql: SELECT CASE WHEN id < 2 THEN 'lo' ELSE 'hi' END FROM range(4) ORDER BY id

name: null_handling
sql: SELECT coalesce(NULL, 3), nullif(2, 2), 1 = NULL, NULL IS NULL

name: decimal_as_string
sql: SELECT CAST(CAST('12.345' AS DECIMAL(10, 3)) * 2 AS STRING), CAST(DATE'2024-02-29' + 1 AS STRING)

name: order_limit
sql: SELECT id FROM range(10) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 3

name: empty_result
sql: SELECT id FROM range(5) WHERE id > 100
